title: Check my Macs
summary: The person's Macs that run mChatAI+: which are online and when each was last seen, through the same bridge as the My Macs applet.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks whether their Mac is on, online or reachable.
_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the My Macs applet for the agent, through its own service.
